herrax.setting: Ten Thousand Delights coin arch and locked private floor
herrax.payoff_shape: madam punishes the would-be successor then admits an unpaid guest; rival serves breakfast

canon_hooks.native_excerpt: "With this, every arch will recognize you as my favored guest and teleport you here. If you wish to spend the night, have some fun, or restock your supplies, come to me. Don't waste your time on my little crooks."
canon_hooks.scope: Characterization/campaign evidence. Citing this cue is not a claim that the Commander heard it in every Trickster history; authored courtship uses only actually known facts.

canon_hooks.native_excerpt: {n}With a chuckle, the incubus reluctantly confesses.{/n} "Seize power? Well, I did try... Have you seen Herrax? After our fight, I looked much worse than that. I had to spend a great deal of gold on healers to restore my appearance. Don't let Herrax's scars fool you — she keeps them to remind us what we looked like after she finished with us..."
